content.short: Ostium is a decentralized perpetual DEX on Arbitrum specializing in RWAs like Gold, Oil, and Forex.
content.description:
Ostium is a professional-grade decentralized perpetual exchange built on Arbitrum, specifically designed to bring traditional real-world assets (RWAs) onto the blockchain. Unlike traditional DEXs focused solely on crypto, Ostium enables users to trade synthetic versions of commodities, indices, and forex pairs—such as Gold, Oil, and EUR/USD—with up to 200x leverage. The protocol utilizes a unique two-tiered liquidity pool model to minimize conflict between traders and liquidity providers, ensuring deep liquidity and minimal slippage.

By leveraging a custom pull-based oracle system, Ostium accurately tracks traditional market hours and price gaps, providing a professional trading experience that rivals centralized platforms while maintaining the security of on-chain settlement. The platform is designed for sophisticated traders seeking diversified exposure beyond digital assets within a non-custodial and transparent framework. As a cornerstone of the RWA landscape on Arbitrum, Ostium is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to trade any asset with professional-grade speed and precision.
